items: STAY ORGANIZED WITH A BLOOM PLANNER 2026-2027 FOR WOMEN! This weekly planner helps you manage your schedule with ease. Choose from 15 stylish cover options—visit our store for more designs and inspiring office essentials.

WEEKLY & MONTHLY LAYOUT FOR EASY PLANNING! Featuring spacious weekly planner pages and two-page monthly planner spreads, this day planner runs from July 2026 through July 2027: 365+ days to track appointments, tasks, and goals.

PORTABLE & CONVENIENT A5 SIZE! Designed for on-the-go use, this appointment book measures 5.5” wide (excluding binding) x 8.25” tall x 0.5” thick—small enough for your purse yet spacious enough to keep you organized.

PREMIUM QUALITY & FUNCTIONAL DESIGN! Durable yet lightweight soft covers featuring glossy lamination, sturdy monthly tabs, luxurious upgraded 110gsm bleed-resistant paper, metal lay-flat spiral binding, dual interior storage pockets, plus a FREE sticker sheet and bookmark.

items.value: Ideal as an ADHD planner, goal-setting journal, and productivity booster, it includes a habit tracker, personal mission statement prompt, vision board, monthly budget log, weekly scheduling templates, 13 note pages, motivational quotes, and more.
